meta.description: Change slides on your computer from your iPhone, Apple Watch or Android phone. See your notes for every slide and a timer that keeps you on track.
meta.og_description: Clicker, notes and talk timer for your iPhone, Apple Watch and Android phone.
hero.lede: Slides Remote turns your iPhone, Apple Watch or Android phone into a presentation remote. Read the notes for the slide you're on, and finish on time.
demo.title: A remote that just works.
demo.sub: Press Start Show, then tap Next. The notes follow the slide and the timer tells you whether you're ahead or behind.
demo.hint: Keyboard works too: <kbd>←</kbd> <kbd>→</kbd> to change slides, <kbd>B</kbd> to blank. The timer runs 20× faster than real life; watch for the wrist taps.
js.press_start: Press Start Show on the remote
js.slide1_notes: Thank everyone for coming. Introduce yourself in one line.
js.slide2_notes: Keep it short. Mention the beta numbers later, not now.
js.slide3_notes: Ask: who was late to a meeting this week? Wait for hands.
js.slide4_notes:
Most teams lose 10 minutes per meeting to setup.
Pause after the number.
js.slide5_notes: Live demo next. Check the second screen is mirrored.
js.slide6_notes: Point to the QR code. Leave five minutes for questions.
features.title: Everything you need at the front of the room.
features.sub: Slides Remote presses the same keys you would, so it works with the presentation apps you already use.
features.apps_body: Keynote, PowerPoint, Google Slides in a browser, Preview and most other presentation apps.
features.link_body: Switches between them by itself. No internet, router or account needed, so it works on any venue's network.
features.notes_body: Write them on your computer or phone. They follow along as you present, on your phone and your wrist.
features.timer_title: A timer that keeps you on track
features.timer_body: Set the talk's length, warnings and a budget per section. See at a glance whether you're ahead or behind.
features.private_body: Pair once with a six-digit code shown on both screens. Everything is encrypted, and nothing leaves your devices.
features.a11y_body: VoiceOver, Voice Control, Dynamic Type at the largest sizes, Reduce Motion and Differentiate Without Colour.
phone.title: Your notes. Your time. One glance.
phone.sub: The slide number, the current section's time left, and what you meant to say, right above big Next and Previous buttons.
phone.tick1: Start and End Show, Blank Screen and Go to Slide, alongside Next and Previous.
phone.tick2: Edit notes on the go. If the same notes changed on the computer, it asks which to keep.
phone.tick3: Several presentations, each with its own notes and timer plan.
phone.tick4: Reconnects by itself if the computer sleeps or you walk out of range. Your screen stays on while you present.
phone.alt1: iPhone remote showing slide 4 of 18, a running timer 3 minutes ahead, and that slide's notes
phone.alt2: Timer plan with talk length, warnings and per-section budgets
watch.title: Present with nothing in your hands.
watch.sub: Change slides with a tap, the Digital Crown or Double Tap. Your watch taps your wrist at each timer warning and when a section runs over.
watch.tick1: Swipe up for notes, then the Show page for Start, End, Blank and the timer.
watch.tick2: Keep in Front keeps the remote on screen with your wrist down for the whole talk.
watch.tick3: Connects directly over Bluetooth, or through your phone when it needs to.
watch.tick4: Wear OS too, with the crown or rotating bezel.
watch.alt1: Apple Watch remote showing slide 4 of 18 with Live badge and timer
watch.alt2: Apple Watch showing notes for the current slide
watch.alt3: Apple Watch Show page with Start Show, Blank and timer controls
mac.title: The free companion app for Mac and Windows.
mac.sub: It sits in your menu bar or tray, keeps your computer awake while remotes are connected, and lets you choose the key each command presses, for each app.
mac.alt1: Slides Remote for Mac dashboard with slide controls, timer and presentation picker
mac.alt2: Editing presentations and per-slide notes on the Mac
mac.alt3: Settings: the key each command presses, for each presentation app
tour.title: Have a look around.
tour.alt1: Remote controls with notes and timer
tour.cap3: A timer that keeps you on track
tour.cap4: All your talks in one place
tour.cap5: Pairs with your computer in seconds
pricing.title: Free to use as a clicker.
pricing.sub: No subscription, no ads, no account. Unlock notes and timers once if you want them.
pricing.free2: Start and End Show, Blank Screen
pricing.pro_note: One-time purchase, no subscription · 7-day free trial
pricing.pro1: Notes for every slide, on phone and watch
pricing.pro3: Talk timer with warnings and section budgets
pricing.pro5: An unlocked device shares with the devices connected to it
req.title: Runs on what you've got.
req.sub: Install the free app on your computer, then a remote on your phone. Same Wi-Fi network, or within Bluetooth range.
req.android: Android 8.0 or later, Wear OS 3 or later
